description:
#Harbor Fireworks Cruise on Northern Lights

Celebrate the last days of summer with friends and family on a 2.5-hour Harbor Fireworks Cruise aboard yacht Northern Lights, offering a crowd-free alternative to watching from shore. Departing from Boston, we’ll cruise through the harbor before heading toward Quincy to view the evening’s fireworks display. Avoid the crowds and enjoy the show from the water aboard Northern Lights, a classic 1920s-style commuter yacht. Our open top deck and wraparound windows in the lower interior provide great viewing areas throughout the vessel. One complimentary drink is included with admission.

Snacks, cheese boards, sandwiches, and flatbreads will also be available for purchase onboard.

#Northern Lights will run in light rain; however, the fireworks display is weather permitting.

Notable sights
Beautiful views of the Boston skyline and iconic waterfront
Seaport District buildings and harbor scenery
An amazing fireworks display
About Northern Lights

Northern Lights is operated by a Coast Guard-certified captain and a friendly, knowledgeable crew trained to assist in the event of an emergency. The motor yacht is styled after classic New England 1920s steamships and is one of the most comfortable and versatile cruise vessels in Boston Harbor.

Northern Lights is 115 feet in length, features six bathrooms, and provides ample seating throughout the vessel for up to 149 passengers. Sit back and relax in our climate-controlled cabin or enjoy the sea breeze from our open top deck. Be sure to visit our fully stocked bar on the main deck for additional refreshments.

What's included
2.5-hour cruise
One complimentary beer, wine, champagne, or soft drink
Additional beverages available for purchase
Fireworks display
What's not included
Snacks, cheese plates, sandwiches, and other food items are available for purchase onboard
Gratuity for the crew is not included with your ticket purchase
